item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 12/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. The weather will be generally fine over the region. A strong northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China later on Sunday and Monday. It will be windy over the coastal areas in the following couple of days. Besides, a broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea next week.
